name: LFM3-VL-2B (with the d1 decision models)

lineage.base_model: LiquidAI/LFM3-1.7B-Base (HF tag); d1-2B is finetuned from LFM3-VL-2B, d1-3B from LFM2.5-VL-3B
lineage.how_derived: vision-language model with an in-house 164M-parameter vision encoder; d1 models are decision variants that answer a list of questions in one forward pass with calibrated probabilities

purpose: Small vision-language model for edge and robotics use: general vision, documents and charts, GUI understanding, grounding, embodied reasoning and (new for Liquid) video input, with step-by-step thinking. The d1 decision models read a situation (text, images) plus a list of questions and return all answers with calibrated probabilities.

license.name: LFM Open License v1.0
license.notes: LFM3-VL-2B card tag license:other (lfm1.0); the license text is the one read in lfm2.5-24b-a2b (identical file in the LFM3-1.7B repo). Commercial use only below 10 million USD annual revenue. The d1 repos carry the same tag; their LICENSE files were not compared. Verdict policy (README, 2026-11-19): this licence term does not lower tona_fit; kept here for an installer label.

architecture.kind: dense tri-hybrid LFM3 language model + 164M vision encoder
architecture.attention: same tri-hybrid language stack as LFM3-1.7B (13 convolutions, 5 sliding-window, 6 global attention)
architecture.why_this_design: Blog: the new vision encoder uses 3x less compute than SigLIP2 and matches Qwen3.5-2B's encoder at 55.9 % average over 13 VLM benchmarks with 2.2x fewer FLOPs. The language-model reasons are those of lfm3-1.7b.

variants.notes: language model only; Q8_0 1.85, BF16 3.47; a separate mmproj file is part of the repo (size not recorded)
decision model built on LFM3-VL-2B; mmproj BF16 0.38 GB, Q8_0 0.2 GB; BF16 repo LiquidAI/d1-2B 3.85 GB
earlier decision model (2026-10-05) on LFM2.5-VL-3B, replaced by d1-2B

engine_support.notes: Official GGUF with mmproj files exists for llama.cpp; Tona has no vision path for it.

strengths: Vision average at the level of Gemma 4 12B at 1.9B parameters (vendor, own 62-benchmark suite)
Document, OCR, GUI and grounding scores strong for the size (vendor)
weaknesses: Agentic category 42.5, far behind GPT-5.6 Luna 56.1 and Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite 62.4 (vendor table)
All numbers vendor-run on a vendor-selected suite
soft.behavior: Step-by-step thinking available; d1 models output typed answers (point, read, estimate, pick, yes/no, score) with probabilities in one pass.
best_for: on-device document, screen and image understanding
fine-tuning for narrow vision tasks (wind-turbine inspection demo in the blog)
avoid_for: agentic computer use as the only brain
soft.maturity: Same vendor and release as lfm3-1.7b; 146k GGUF downloads in a month.

tona_fit.reason: Tiny vision model that may serve document or screenshot subtasks beside a coding model; no independent evidence yet. Compare against other small VLMs in the documents-vision area before any decision.
blockers: no vision path or lfm3 backend in Tona

sources.note: metadata and file list through the HF API; README not read in full
benchmark tables, encoder and d1 description read through a page summarizer (WebFetch)
